description: How a host resolves which model answers when a chain offers more than one — the rule the chain FOLLOWS, which is a different fact from the order of the chain itself. Pin is the default (0) on purpose: an unset policy must not silently fall back to another model, because switching models mid-run is a decision a host has to make explicitly. The surface paints the policy as a word, never as a colour, so a reader can tell a pinned single model from an ordered fallback.
usageExample:
var chain = new[] { new FallbackChainEntry("gpt-4o", "GPT-4o") };
var policy = FallbackResolutionPolicy.Pin; // nothing falls back until the host says so
